description: Java class implementing a command handler for allocating cash to a cashier within the Fineract project. It processes commands related to the 'ALLOCATECASHTOCASHIER' action and delegates the operation to the TellerWritePlatformService.

classes.name: AllocateCashToCashierCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles commands to allocate cash to a cashier, identified by custom annotations for command type and entity-action.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to allocate cash to a cashier, delegating the operation to the write platform service.
